definitions.explanation: A natural hollow or opening in rock, typically large enough to enter. Used in both everyday and geological contexts.

examples.japanese: {洞穴|ほらあな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しかった→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: It was cool inside the cave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洞穴|ほらあな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧。

⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{洞穴|ほらあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、コウモリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何百匹|なんびゃっぴき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{住|す}みついて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Deep in the mountains there was a large cave where hundreds of bats had made their home.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧けつ in formal or scientific contexts. ほらあな is the standard everyday reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洞穴|ほらあな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a cave
- {洞穴|ほらあな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explore a cave
- {洞穴|ほらあな}⟦{壁画|へきが}→壁画：28980_hekiga⟧: cave paintings

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧ is the more common word for "cave" overall and refers to the same thing. {洞穴|ほらあな} is somewhat less frequent and has a more descriptive, old-fashioned feel.

FORMS:
{洞|ほら} (cave) + ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧ (hole).
